posts.cooked:
Greetings!

Patch 34.4.1 is a server-side hotfix patch, rolling out Jan 20th. Please select the relevant topic below for further details.

Bug Fixes and Game Improvements

Hearthstone

  • Timethief Rafaam: Battlecry should now trigger reliably after all prerequisites are met.

  • Husk, Eternal Reaper: Heroes with Eternal Life and 0 Corpses can once again be destroyed by effects.

  • Battle at the End Time: Now works with Plot Twist and Gaslight Gatekeeper

  • The Fins Beyond Time: Fixed a disconnect that could occur when combined with effects that trigger end of turn twice (e.g., Chrono‑Lord Deios, Drakkari Enchanter).

  • Emergency Maneuvers: No longer summons 0‑Health copies

  • Morchie now works with Bygone Doomspeaker

Battlegrounds

  • Timewarped Embalmer: Now correctly grants Reborn when you Magnetize a minion.

  • Profound Thinker: If it gains Windfury during combat (e.g., via Spellcraft), it will now attack twice as expected.

  • Timewarped Lubber: Fixed an issue where, after Lubber was refreshed into the Tavern, only Tavern Spells would appear in the shop.

  • Timewarped Shivarra + Timewarped Devourer: Shivarra now copies the devoured minion’s full stats (including buffs), not just base stats.

  • Whelp Watcher + Hand of Deios: Resolved a combat issue that could make Whelp Watcher un-interactive.

  • Golden Timewarped Warghoul: Will no longer trigger the Deathrattle of another Golden Warghoul.

  • Stone Age Slab: Effect now refreshes correctly each turn after use.

  • Embalming Expert (Golden): Card text now updates correctly when tripled.

  • Golden Timewarped Electron: Now Magnetizes 4/4 Satellites twice (as intended) and its text matches the effect.

  • Timewarped Murky: Now improves from Battlecries that trigger from other sources (e.g., Brann Bronzebeard, Rylak Metalhead), not just when you play a Battlecry minion.

  • Reclaimed Souls (Sylvanas): You can no longer use the Hero Power with a full hand (which previously burned the discovered minion and caused odd VFX). See Sylvanas Windrunner.

  • Timewarped Hyena: Fixed cases where Hyena would miss buffs from Rabid Panther after stats were set by other effects.

  • Greybough (Festergut interaction): Undead creations no longer carry buffs into your hand. (Related: Timewarped Festergut.)

  • Timewarped Lasso: Can now be used even when the Tavern has no minions, as intended.

  • Alternate Timeline (Murozond, Unbounded): From the opponent’s view, the remaining turns counter now updates correctly.

Timewarped Tavern Adjustments

Minor Timewarps
  • Timewarped Greenskeeper – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Deathswarmer – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Kil’rek – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Piper – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Ragnaros – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Guard – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Scourfin – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Shadowdancer – Cost reduced

  • Timewarped Snow Elemental – Cost increased
  • Timewarped Bassgill – Cost increased
  • Timewarped Acolyte – Cost increased
  • Timewarped Leapfrogger – Cost increased
  • Power of George – Cost increased
Major Timewarps
  • Timewarped Stormcloud – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Murk-Eye – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Mystic – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Steamer – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Tide Razor – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Bonker – Cost reduced
  • Timewarped Siren – Cost reduced

  • Timewarped Geist – Cost increased
  • Timewarped Substrate – Cost increased
  • Timewarped Shivarra – Cost increased
Card pool updates

The following cards will return to the Timewarp Pool:

  • Timewarped Lubber
  • Timewarped Guard
  • Timewarped Ragnaros

  • Bonus turn time on Timewarp turns reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds

  • Additionally, we’ve disabled the visual effect associated with buffs to right‑most minions in the Tavern such as from En‑Djinn Blazer. This is a visuals‑only change, and is intended to address difficulties making full use of some cards/strategies (e.g. Acid Rainfall).
